s.t:
Join Apaleo and Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech!
Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.
As Apaleo accelerates international expansion, compliance has become one of the most strategically critical capabilities we own. We're looking for someone to do something ambitious: transform how Apaleo handles fiscal and compliance requirements across global markets, moving from reactive, country-by-country firefighting to a scalable platform capability that makes expansion repeatable, fast, and low-risk.
If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human, and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you.
What You'll Be Up To
This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. The work you drive directly determines how fast Apaleo can expand internationally. You will own the product vision, roadmap, and architectural direction for the entire Fiscal & Compliance domain, operating as a peer to our Product Compliance Leader, where they bring regulatory intelligence and you translate it into platform strategy and delivery.
Fiscal framework vision & scalable market enablement
Define and drive the long-term architectural vision for how Apaleo handles fiscal compliance at scale, one that transforms new-market enablement from bespoke engineering projects into scalable, configuration-driven workflows. Own the investment case for this platform-level work, defend it against short-term feature pressure, and hold yourself accountable for the outcome: measurably faster and cheaper fiscal provider integrations and new country launches.
Roadmap ownership & strategic prioritisation Own the Fiscal & Compliance product roadmap end-to-end: from regulatory signal to architectural decision to crew-level delivery. Make prioritisation trade-offs transparently, deciding when to take on a new country requirement, when to defer, and when to invest in foundational capability instead.
Turf leadership & team development Lead and develop the Crew-level PM(s) within the turf, providing direction, coaching, and clear ownership boundaries. Depending on team shape and capacity, you may also directly own one of the crews, particularly where the work is foundational or tightly coupled to the vision.
Cross-functional leadership Work as a peer with the Product Compliance Leader: they bring regulatory intelligence and country strategy; you translate that into product decisions and delivery. Collaborate with BD and CS to ensure the roadmap reflects commercial priorities.

s.h: What You'll Bring to the Team
s.t:
Required Experience & Competencies
5+ years in product management, with at least 2 years in a senior or lead role owning a platform domain or complex infrastructure product area.
Demonstrated experience driving platform-level investment decisions, not just feature delivery, but architectural thinking with multi-year consequences.
Background in fiscal, financial, or compliance-adjacent product domains (fintech, ERP, tax-tech, PMS, or similar) to engage credibly with regulatory complexity, even if you're not a primary specialist.
Intellectually honest about domain gaps, with a concrete plan to close them, comfortable working alongside a domain expert rather than needing to be one.
Experience leading or mentoring other PMs, with a clear management or coaching track record.
Strong prioritisation instincts under competing pressures, with a track record of defending foundational investment against short-term demands.
Excellent communication skills, able to make complex platform trade-offs legible to engineers, senior leadership, and commercial stakeholders alike.

Prior exposure to hospitality technology or PMS platforms.
Experience owning a compliance or fiscalization project through multiple market expansions.
Familiarity with European fiscal regulatory landscape and what it takes to build compliant products across these markets.
What early success looks like
A fiscal integration framework vision is defined, socialised, and has engineering investment allocated to it.
The time and cost of connecting a fiscal provider to a new market has measurably reduced.
The team is operating with a forward-looking roadmap, not a reactive backlog.
Platform investment and technical debt reduction are treated as explicit roadmap streams alongside regulatory delivery.

Culture & Growth
A Diverse & International Team: Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique cultural perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.
Growth & Development: As we scale, so do your opportunities. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget, and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Our evolving career framework ensures you have increasing opportunities to learn new skills, advance your career, and make an impact.
Autonomy & Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions, and contribute directly in an environment built on trust, transparency, and collaboration.
Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech: Be part of a fast-growing scale-up transforming the hospitality industry. From day one, your work drives real impact and you'll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.
Competitive & Fair Compensation: We believe great work deserves great pay. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. We make sure to recognize and reward performance and contribution.

Flexible & Remote Work Options: We focus on results, not clocking hours. You can work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup, with flexibility to adapt your schedule as long as it makes sense for your role, your team and our business.
Free Public Transport: Travel across Germany with ease using our fully covered Deutschland Ticket .
Team Connection: Strong connections fuel collaboration. We celebrate and connect through regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties, and other offsite events.
Paid Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge, and return inspired.
Health & Wellbeing: Prioritize your health with access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios, and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership.
How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo means more than just taking on a role, it's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions, and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued, and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation, and growth is a shared journey.

Better Money Strike is the Bitcoin company. With Strike , you can buy and sell bitcoin, pay bills, and borrow against your holdings. From individuals to businesses, Strike is purpose-built for every step of the Bitcoin journey.

Available in more than 100 countries — including the U.S., Europe, Latin America, and Africa — Strike is building a better financial system powered by Bitcoin. Bitcoin is better money. Strike is how you use it. Role: Strike is where people around the world send, save, and spend money on bitcoin rails.

For a product like that, customer trust is a feature in and of itself.

As Trust Product Manager, you'll own the features that make customers confident keeping their money with Strike : account security controls, verified support experiences, beneficiary planning, account management, and the systems like KYC/B, transaction limits, account restrictions that keep fraudsters out without getting in the way of good customers.

You'll ship customer-facing features, and you'll own the foundations underneath them, turning what most companies treat as friction into experiences customers actually appreciate.

You'll succeed by shipping trust-building features customers love, minimizing fraud, maintaining compliance, and protecting the health and integrity of the Strike ecosystem. This position is available for candidates located in the eastern US time zone.

What You’ll Do: Serve as the voice of the customer (internal customer too!) and intimately understand the products we offer as well as their potential fraud vectors and blind spots Work closely with Compliance, Finance, Operations, and Data to uncover and understand needs Partner with cross-functional peers to define, prioritize, and deliver a roadmap and product that maximize impact to financial risk management and our fraud strategy Own our Fraud KPIs and partner with Data and Finance to iterate on their definition as needed Establish and track success metrics for various features and initiatives, including operational efficiencies Support and motivate cross-functional teams through an inclusive and collaborative mindset Qualifications: At least 4 years of experience in product management, with at least 2 of those years in trust/fraud related teams A highly experimental mindset to drive innovation amidst uncertainty or ambiguity (e.g., new processes, teams, systems) Vast experience working with designers and user researchers Empathy to work with a diverse array of cross functional peers and stakeholders Resourcefulness, pragmatism and roll-up the sleeves mentality Excellent verbal and written communication skills Experience and interest for Bitcoin and Fintech is a plus US-Based Positions Salary range: $162K - 190K Equity in a high-growth startup Health, dental, and vision insurance premium contributions; short & long-term disability insurance and basic life insurance Cell phone and internet reimbursement Flexible PTO, sick leave & parental leave Access to a company 401k plan We do not make hiring decisions based on educational history whatsoever.

Our Founder is a college dropout. We employ high school dropouts, PHD candidates and everything in-between. We do not hire credentials. We simply hire talented, passionate individuals who are excited to be a part of our team.

Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products.

Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

Responsibilities: Work directly with merchants and PSP partners to guide them through the full integration lifecycle, from solution design and API integration to testing, go-live, and post-launch support. Lead technical discussions with merchant product and engineering teams to design optimal integration approaches using Binance payment solutions.

Act as the primary liaison between merchants, product managers, and engineering teams to ensure smooth communication and efficient problem solving. Provide hands-on support during merchant integrations, helping troubleshoot technical issues and ensuring a high integration success rate.

Educate merchants on integration best practices, API usage, and optimal payment flows for both web and mobile environments. Support merchants in designing effective checkout experiences and payment UI/UX to improve end-user conversion and payment success rates.

Conduct integration testing with merchants and internal teams to validate payment flows and ensure readiness for launch. Analyze merchant feedback, performance data, and market trends to identify opportunities to improve Binance payment products and integration tools.

Collaborate with product teams to close functionality gaps and propose enhancements that improve merchant integration experience. Engage with merchants regularly to understand their needs, gather insights, and help optimize their payment integration over time.

Requirements: 5+ years of experience in payment integrations, fintech, or merchant-facing technical roles Experience working with payment gateways, PSPs, or merchant payment solutions Strong understanding of REST APIs and integration workflows Ability to work directly with merchant product or engineering teams to guide technical integrations Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders Experience coordinating cross-functional teams across product, engineering, and business Familiarity with web or mobile technologies (JavaScript, Node.js, HTML5, Java, Python, etc.) is a plus Knowledge in crypto or Web3 payment infrastructure is a strong advantage Why Binance
· Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
· Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
· Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
· Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
· Competitive salary and company benefits
· Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team) Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success. By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice . Agentic AI ist deine Welt – und du willst dich damit beschäftigen, statt ständig etwas verkaufen zu müssen?
Du hast dich intensiv mit KI-Agenten beschäftigt, eigene Workflows oder Anwendungen gebaut und kennst Themen wie n8n, Make, APIs, Tool Calling, RAG, Vektordatenbanken oder MCP aus der Praxis?
Dann bau mit uns den besten Agentic-AI-Kurs im deutschsprachigen Raum.
Aufgaben
Der Titel heißt Product Manager – gemeint ist aber jemand, der Lerninhalte baut, nichtverwaltet: halb Instructional Designer, halb Agentic-AI-Bastler. Du gestaltest das Produkt „Kurs“, von der ersten Demo bis zum fertigen Modul. Dabei beschäftigst du dich mit uns zusammen unter anderem mit folgenden Fragen:
Was müssen Menschen heute über Agentic AI wissen?
Welche Tools, Modelle und Frameworks sind wirklich relevant?
Welche Agenten und Automatisierungen sollten Teil des Kurses sein?
Wie lassen sich technische Inhalte verständlich und praxisnah vermitteln?
Welche Übungen, Projekte und Demos bringen Teilnehmer wirklich weiter?
Du unterstützt uns dabei, Inhalte zu strukturieren, praktische Anwendungen zu bauen, Lernmaterialien zu entwickeln und Referenten fachlich zu begleiten. Einzelne Inhalte kannst du später auch selbst unterrichten.
Qualifikation
Wir suchen keinen Verkäufer und keinen klassischen Bildungsmanager – sondern jemanden mit technischem Hintergrund, der bereits tief in Agentic AI steckt, neue Entwicklungen aufmerksam verfolgt und komplexe Dinge verständlich erklären kann.
Ob Berufseinsteiger mit starkem Portfolio oder mit ein paar Jahren Erfahrung in Content, Training oder Produktentwicklung – entscheidend ist, was du bereits gebaut oder vermittelt hast, nicht dein Titel.

Kleines Team, kurze Wege
Hybrides Arbeits-Setup: Büro in Berlin-Mitte + Homeoffice
Tägliche Arbeit mit den aktuellsten KI-Tools und -Entwicklungen
Echte Verantwortung ab Tag 1 - du verwaltest nicht, du baust auf
Perspektive auf eine wachsende Rolle in einem wachsenden Bereich
Vollzeit, unbefristet.
Schick uns nicht nur deinen Lebenslauf – zeig uns, womit du dich beschäftigst und was du bereits gebaut oder entwickelt hast (z.B. Kurskonzepte, Workshops, Tutorials oder Prototypen)!

At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world. ​ Job Overview Product Manager – OTB Solutions Job Overview & Opportunity At TE Connectivity , our Product Management teams help shape the technologies that enable the world's most advanced AI, cloud, and networking infrastructure.

The Product Manager – OTB Solutions will lead a portfolio of high-speed datacenter interconnect products and help drive strategy, innovation, commercialization, and lifecycle management across a growing global business.

This role combines strategic thinking, customer engagement, business leadership, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver solutions that address evolving customer and market needs.

The successful candidate will partner closely with Sales, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Marketing, and customers to translate market opportunities into profitable growth and successful product outcomes.

This role offers broad visibility across the organization and the opportunity to influence product strategy, investment priorities, and customer success. Why This Role Matters OTB products play an important role in enabling next-generation AI and cloud infrastructure.

In this position, you will help shape technologies that support some of the world's most innovative datacenter platforms while working alongside customers, ecosystem partners, and technology leaders across the industry.

This opportunity provides meaningful exposure to portfolio strategy, new product development, commercial execution, and customer engagement in a highly collaborative environment. Short Description Key Responsibilities Portfolio Strategy & Market Insight
· Develop product and portfolio strategies aligned with customer needs, technology trends, and business priorities.
· Monitor market developments, competitive activity, and emerging opportunities.
· Contribute to product roadmaps and investment decisions that support long-term growth.
· Help define compelling value propositions and market positioning. Business & Commercial Leadership
· Support achievement of revenue, profitability, and market growth objectives.
· Develop business cases, financial analyses, and portfolio recommendations.
· Partner with Sales, Finance, Operations, and Engineering to align business plans and execution priorities.
· Contribute to pricing, commercial strategy, and customer engagement activities. New Product Development & Customer Engagement
· Lead commercialization efforts for new product initiatives from concept through launch.
· Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure solutions meet customer, quality, and operational requirements.
· Engage directly with customers to understand challenges, identify opportunities, and support design-win activity.
· Help drive successful execution of strategic development programs. Product Lifecycle Management
· Support portfolio optimization and continuous improvement initiatives.
· Partner with teams to address product, quality, delivery, and customer-related challenges.
· Contribute to forecasting, demand planning, and inventory management activities.
· Enable commercial success through customer-facing communications, training, and sales support. What Success Looks Like Success in this role is demonstrated through:
· Strong portfolio business performance
· Successful execution of new product introductions
· Improved customer engagement and design-win growth
· Effective cross-functional collaboration
· Delivery of profitability, operational, and business objectives
· Continuous learning, team contribution, and leadership influence What your background should look like: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Experience in product management, engineering, sales, field applications, business management, or a related role within a technology-focused environment. Experience supporting new product development, commercialization, or product lifecycle activities. Strong analytical, business, and problem-solving skills. Ability to influence and collaborate across cross-functional teams. Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills. Preferred Qualifications
· Experience in datacenter infrastructure, AI systems, networking, interconnects, connectors, cables, sockets, or related technologies.
· Experience working with hyperscalers, OEMs, ODMs, silicon providers, or other strategic technology customers.
· Knowledge of portfolio management, pricing strategy, business planning, or financial analysis.
· Understanding of high-speed interconnect technologies and datacenter architectures.
· MBA and advanced technical degree, or equivalent relevant experience. Competencies Motivating Others Building Effective Teams Managing and Measuring Work Values: Integrity, Accountability, Inclusion, Innovation, Teamwork SET : Strategy, Execution, Talent (for managers) ABOUT TE CONNECTIVITY TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more. Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www.te.com and on LinkedIn , Facebook , WeChat, Instagram and X (formerly Twitter). COMPENSATION
· Competitive base salary commensurate with experience: $153,200 – $229,700 (subject to change dependent on physical location)
· Posted salary ranges are made in good faith. TE Connectivity reserves the right to adjust ranges depending on the experience/qualification of the selected candidate as well as internal and external equity.
· Total Compensation = Base Salary + Incentive(s) + Benefits BENEFITS

Description This role requires two in-office days per week for candidates who live within 50 miles of Portsmouth, NH; Plano, TX; Seattle, WA; or Boston, MA.
USRM Electronic Content Solutions (ECS) is seeking a Product Owner to join our Forms Development team, responsible for delivering scalable, compliant, and cost-effective insurance form solutions for Auto, Property, and Umbrella products.

This role is integral to enabling Liberty Mutual's ability to bring policy forms to market quickly and accurately while supporting regulatory compliance, profitability programs, and platform convergence initiatives. You'll work within a mature, high-throughput forms factory model serving USRM's largest business priorities.
Join a team at the center of how Liberty Mutual brings insurance products to market. You'll own the delivery of policy form content that directly impacts profitability, regulatory compliance, and customer experience — while shaping a modernizing forms ecosystem undergoing significant convergence and operating model evolution. If you thrive on balancing speed, quality, and stakeholder complexity in a high-throughput environment, this is your role.

Experience in insurance forms, document management, or publishing/content management systems
Familiarity with regulatory/compliance filing processes and state-level insurance requirements beneficial
Background working with form template technologies (e.g., LibreOffice, open-source document generation tools, or similar)
Experience managing vendor/contractor delivery
Comfort working across multiple stakeholders (forms analysts, compliance, product, engineering) in a matrixed environment
Understanding of SLA-driven delivery models and cycle time optimization
Experience with agile delivery at scale

Contributes to the creation of product vision and alignment with strategic priorities with stakeholders. Communicates the product and portfolio vision to their squad/team and other squads/teams outside their portfolio/functional area.
With the squad/team, contributes towards achieving assigned product KPIs.
Manages form development product delivery across multiple lines of business (Auto, Property, Umbrella) with increasing complexity driven by regulatory requirements, multi-brand convergence, and cross-portfolio dependencies
Owns and maintains the product backlog and is accountable for its contents, prioritization, and acceptance criteria. Accountable for clear, actionable user stories.
Sets priorities and actively participates in squad/team quarterly planning. Sets expectations with stakeholders for delivery of new capabilities, features, and functionalities. Participates in PI Planning ceremonies and sets sprint/PI-level priorities in alignment with ECS OKRs, USRM business priorities, and forms analyst filing timelines
Participates in squad/team demos, retrospectives, and all other ceremonies.
Works daily with the Agile working group clarifying business requirements, removing roadblocks, constantly communicating, and supporting alignment around product strategy. Contributes to aligning development and business goals and priorities while working with stakeholders and squad/team to remove roadblocks to execution.
Monitors and maintains the product health, supporting long-term product viability and efficiency, and balancing long and short term and costs with desired outcomes.
Analyzes feasibility, cost of delay ramifications, economies, or other aspects of planned or potential changes to the product.
Understands regulatory, compliance, and other industry constraints on the product and prioritizes accordingly. Negotiates with immediate squads/teams to ensure priorities are aligned in a portfolio.
Collaboratively builds the squad/team product roadmap based on strategy and ongoing input from stakeholders. Communicates expected value and any changes in value to be delivered in each iteration (sprint, monthly, quarterly, etc.) based on the squad/team-determined capacity.
Partners with contract analysts, Product domain teams, and ECS engineering leadership to maintain a rolling 12-month roadmap that accounts for state filings, program launches, modernization milestones, and form rationalization targets
Contributes in customer-driven design and usability testing. Ensures a well-positioned product through market & industry analysis.
Drives cost efficiency through form rationalization, reuse standards, and scalable solutions
Partners with vendor form development teams to manage delivery throughput, quality, and adherence to defined SOPs and standards
Qualifications Knowledge of Agile development methodologies and IT project management as typically acquired through a Bachelors` degree in relevant field (business, computer science, humanities, etc.) and a minimum of 2 to 4 years direct experience with agile teams as well as 5 years in business, technology or consulting.
Able to depict complex ideas, issues and designs to varied audiences; educate SBU/department(s) on business vision and plan and the impact of change.
Able to make difficult and quick decisions daily.
Problem solver with ability to lead the team to push the solutions and progress.

You will build payment infrastructure for a sector that is running out of capacity and we are all depending on.
By 2050, 38 million people across the EU will need long-term care, and the sector already lacks the workforce to deliver it. Care organisations need technology that gives professionals more time for people. We build the payment infrastructure that makes this possible.
Your job: build and ship the products for it.
Parto is the all-in-one payments platform for social care organisations. We digitise cash, expense, and payment processes in youth services, disability support, and elderly care - making them simple, secure, and fully digital.
With Parto Visa cards and our software platform, care professionals can efficiently manage client funds, team budgets, and everyday operational expenses. We reduce administrative work, eliminate disconnected processes, and create lasting relief for care teams, administration, and finance departments.
Parto is backed by Motive Ventures New York/Berlin, Heal Capital Berlin and Shapers Lisbon, plus experienced business angels.
You will join an ambitious team whose experience includes Trade Republic, JPMorgan Chase, CHECK24 Bank, Strategy&, and Ruuky . Together, we are building a new category of financial software for one of society's most important sectors.
Tasks
As Product Manager at Parto , you will play a defining role in the future of our platform.
You will be our second product manager, working directly with our founder and CPO, alongside a product designer and an engineering team of 11. Small team, large surface area: your decisions ship.
You will build digital financial products for the social care sector and help modernise an industry that urgently needs better technology. Your work will solve real problems and shape how thousands of professionals manage money every day .
This is not a role in which requirements are handed to you. You will own initiatives from the first customer insight through discovery, prioritisation, delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement .
You will work AI-native from day one . Every PM at Parto uses AI agents daily for discovery, analysis, specs, and delivery. We expect you to push what a single PM can own.
Together with engineering and product design, you will ensure that we solve the right problems and turn them into products that create measurable value.

Develop a deeper understanding of our users, their workflows, and their constraints than anyone else in the company.
Translate customer conversations, user feedback, product data, regulatory requirements, and company goals into clear product decisions.
Own and prioritise your roadmap based on outcomes and strategic leverage, and make difficult scope decisions while keeping your team moving at high speed.
Lead discovery and turn ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses, requirements, and measures of success.
Work closely with engineering and product design from the earliest idea through launch, adoption, and iteration.
Own integrations with external partners and third-party systems, including the operational details required to make them successful.
Contribute to Parto's long-term product strategy and help define the category we intend to lead.
What success looks like in your first six months
Months 1-2: Understand and take ownership
You develop a detailed understanding of our users, product, business model, and technology. You establish strong relationships with customers and your engineering counterparts, challenge existing assumptions, and take ownership of your first product area.
Months 3-4: Ship and learn
You lead your first meaningful initiative from problem definition to launch. You establish clear success metrics, remove blockers quickly, and build a direct feedback loop between customers and the product team.
Months 5-6: Raise the bar
You independently drive your roadmap, make difficult prioritisation decisions, and demonstrate measurable impact. Your understanding of customers begins to shape Parto's broader product strategy.
We work with real startup intensity. The pace is high, the problems are unsolved, and the learning curve is steep. If you are looking for a quiet position with fixed instructions and a rigid scope, you will not be happy at Parto.
If you want to build a product category from the ground up, take real responsibility, and become better at your craft faster than almost anywhere else, we would love to meet you.
What working at Parto means
You make consequential decisions yourself and take responsibility for the results.
Feedback is direct, frequent, and expected in both directions.
You create clarity instead of waiting for perfect instructions.
You move quickly without compromising on the quality of important decisions.
You adapt when new evidence challenges the current plan.

Must-haves
At least three years of product management experience, ideally in FinTech, payments, or another complex B2B SaaS environment.
A strong track record of owning products or major initiatives end-to-end and delivering measurable customer or business impact.
The ability to turn complex and sometimes conflicting requirements into clear product decisions and priorities.
Strong analytical skills and confidence using qualitative and quantitative evidence to make decisions.
High agency and relentless ownership. You identify what matters, create a path forward, and stay with the problem until it is solved.
A hands-on mindset and the ability to move confidently between product strategy and operational detail.
Experience working closely with engineers and product designers in a fast-moving startup or scale-up environment.
The ability to build trust with customers and manage internal and external stakeholders at different levels.
Technical fluency to discuss APIs, system integrations, data flows, dependencies, and technical trade-offs with engineers.
Native German level and professional fluency in English, our company language.
Nice-to-haves
Experience in payments, banking, expense management, or card products.
Familiarity with accounting processes and financial reconciliation.
Experience with ERP integrations or mission-critical B2B software.
Experience building products in regulated environments.
Understanding of social care, healthcare, or other operationally complex service industries.
We do not expect you to match every item. We care more about your judgement, trajectory, and evidence of exceptional ownership than a perfectly linear CV.

Build something that matters: Create a new category of software for a sector that is both economically important and socially essential.
Real ownership and impact: Your decisions will directly influence how hundreds of organisations and thousands of professionals work.
Accelerated personal growth: Receive direct feedback, meaningful responsibility, and opportunities to grow faster than in a narrowly defined role.
Competitive compensation and ownership: Receive a fair salary plus virtual company shares through our VSOP programme.
A greenfield environment: Shape the product, operating model, and culture while the most important decisions are still ahead of us.

Our customer-facing dashboard already serves merchandisers well, and the next challenge is expanding the reach to every persona responsible for conversion: product managers, marketers, analysts, and executives.

Develop and execute a comprehensive product strategy and metrics for business intelligence and insights that position Constructor as an indispensable product discovery platform for driving e-commerce business.
Build clear and actionable reporting that communicates Constructor's impact on business metrics and is designed to be consumed and shared across multiple personas through the right channels (customer app, email, exports, conversational AI).
Own the cross-product revenue breakdown: surface how each step in the shopping journey drives e-commerce business as the shared mental model that unifies merchandisers, product managers, marketers, analysts, and executives.
Drive proactive, actionable insights at each step of the product discovery journey — not just data on what's happening, but why it's happening and what to do next.
Lead and scale a cross-functional team of engineers and a designer, while owning the full product cycle from discovery to prototyping, implementation, launching, enabling fellow teams and customers, and iterating on results.
Conduct customer research across multiple personas and industries to understand how different stakeholders consume analytics, make decisions, and prove value internally.
Collaborate closely with fellow product teams to ensure data quality and actionability in merchandising, explainability, reporting, and AI agent workflows.
Communicate effectively at all levels to ensure wonderful experience for customers, prospects, GTM teams, and internal stakeholders, by setting the right expectations and providing regular updates on product strategy, roadmap, and progress against key initiatives and team metrics.

You are a data storyteller — you can take complex e-commerce data and translate it into compelling, value-based, and actionable narratives tailored to different audiences: executives, PMs, merchandisers, marketers.

You are naturally curious about new ideas and products.
You seek a fast-moving entrepreneurial environment and thrive in ever-evolving processes.

Anyone can build AI insurance software now. The models are commoditized. The demos work. Almost nobody starts where Agency Revolution starts: thousands of independent P&C agencies already paying us to communicate with their clients, plus deep integrations into the systems where agency data actually lives.
The opportunity is the relationship layer — the system that notices when an agency's clients are at risk of churning, spots the cross-sell opportunity, picks the right message and channel and moment, and acts. We call it RelationshipOS. For ten years, agencies have trusted us to speak to their clients.

Now we're expanding what we can see: call transcripts, carrier communications, life events. The policies live in the agency's management system. The relationship lives with us. Nobody else has both the permission and the infrastructure.
We know what we're betting on. We don't yet know what makes an agency owner act on it. That's the job.
The strategic thesis is set. What's unresolved is whether it's true — whether an agency will actually change what they do because our system told them to, and what has to be built for that to happen. You're hired to answer that by shipping, not by studying.

s.h: Two halves, and you need both
s.t:
You personally build the bet. The intelligence layer is your work. Discovery with agency owners, prototypes in front of them within days, the smallest version that proves someone will act. Much of this is assembled rather than authored — the right vendor wired into AR Connect and pointed at a real use case will beat anything we could build from scratch this year. You don't hand this half to your team; it's too early and too ambiguous to delegate.
Your team drives the day-to-day execution and health of the existing platform. Two Product Owners and a Product Analyst keep a profitable, decade-old product healthy and improving. You set their priorities, strengthen their product judgment, raise their craft, and shield them from thrash. You remain the primary product manager responsible for the roadmap, discovery, and strategic product decisions. Done well, this is what buys you the time to do the first half.
Most people are good at one of these. We need someone who won't quietly abandon the other.
This position offers $125,000-$140,000 depending on experience and qualifications.

RelationshipOS — the intelligence layer. Churn signals. Cross-sell opportunities. Adaptive customer journeys instead of rigid sequences. You define what "acted on" means, instrument it, and are accountable for the number.
AR Connect and the vendor stack. AR Connect is our integration layer — where APIs pull in calls, carrier communications, life events, and other signals, and where third-party capability plugs into our distribution. It's the substrate the whole thesis sits on, and it's how a promising vendor becomes a live use case in front of agencies.
That work is yours: mapping the landscape of management systems, carrier connections, data enrichment providers, and AI vendors; deciding what we integrate versus build; running the POCs; and getting from "interesting demo" to something an agency actually uses. Data quality, latency, unit economics, and what happens when a vendor's model is wrong are your problems to surface early. You shape the deals and bring the recommendation — the SVP and our partnership team close them.
Voice AI as a channel. Not a feature — a real channel. Define the MVP, run pilots where AI handles outbound outreach with warm handoffs to agencies, and produce the evidence for whether this moves us from subscription toward outcome-based pricing.
The Agency Revolution roadmap. What ships, in what order, and what we stop doing. You own the sequencing and defend it.

Technische Fluenz: Solides Verständnis von Softwareentwicklungs-Workflows und -Architektur sowie die Fähigkeit, effektiv mit Engineering- und Data-Science-Teams zu kommunizieren.
Hands-on Mindset: Fähigkeit, schnelle, funktionale Prototypen mittels No-Code/Low-Code-Tools oder einfachen Skripten zu erstellen sowie Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit externen Entwicklern.
Soft Skills & Führung: Exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, starkes Stakeholder-Management, Growth Mindset und hohe Eigenverantwortung.
Sprachen: Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2-Niveau).

Einfluss ab Tag 1: Werde Teil eines missionsgetriebenen Teams, in dem deine Ideen und Fähigkeiten reale Produkte von Grund auf prägen.
Autonomie: Kurze Entscheidungswege und hohe Eigenverantwortung in einem hochkollaborativen Arbeitsumfeld.
